title: 9.5 The Sine and Cosine Ratios

icans: I can find the sine and cosine of an acute angle in a right triangle.
I can use sine and cosine to find missing sides of a right triangle.
I can use the cofunction relationship and angles of depression to solve problems.

vocab: the angle from the _____________ down to your line of sight

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: the other two ratios

blocks.p: Draw a right triangle with a 35° angle and a hypotenuse of 10 cm. Measure both legs. The other acute angle is 55°.
What do you notice about the 35° row and the 55° row?

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Cofunctions: if A and B are complementary, then sin A = _______________ and cos A = _______________.
